subject: Burmese python
title: A Python's Heart Grows 40% in 2 Days, Then Shrinks Back

scenes.text: This snake's heart swells by almost half in just two days.
After a big meal, a Burmese python's heart muscle gains around 40 percent in mass within 48 hours.
Its oxygen use jumps about sevenfold while it digests.
Its liver grows to about three times its size, and its gut roughly doubles.
When the meal is gone, the heart shrinks back. Scientists study it for clues to human heart disease.
A heart that grows when it's needed, and shrinks when it's done.

description:

first_comment: A python's body rebuilds itself after every meal. Which organ would you want to regrow on demand?
